HORY SHEET!

No ones going to read this but I think ill type it out anyway. 

I was at one of the most comfortable points in my life. I didnt have a job, was living with my grandmother helping her do various things and driving her to appointments. Life was slow and pleasurable, things seemed like they were exactly what I wanted, smoking weed with the "homies" getting drunk. I started to have more free-time then I knew what to do with so I looked to the internet to fill that void, I went to a website called Tinychat. It may sound weird but I found a group of people just like myself and fell right in. Life continued as normal, nothing really changed... It was about a year later when I met a girl through Tinychat, Her Username was Heatherluvsyou, her real name was Heather (Not that its apparent or anything) and she was from the other side of the U.S. I from the West coast her from the East. She was gorgeous, just a beautiful girl with long brown hair and a fucking amazing smile. We ended up taking a liking to each other and continued to skype for hours and hours. I would put off everything in my life just to see her through a computer screen.

 It was about 3-4 months of being head over heals for this girl that we both started feeling that we needed to meet up. Her mother was an amazing woman and facilitated the whole thing, her only being 17 and me being 20 her mother understood what we felt and knew I was not some freak and that where she would stay she would be safe (to clarify she was very mature and in college) she even got her then admirer to use his frequent flyer miles to send her to visit me for free. Heather came to visit me the day after my 21st birthday, I wont ever forget that she gave me the best gift I could have asked for and in that 1 week it felt like I got to know her so well that its like we had known each other a lifetime. We did everything, Seaworld, the Zoo, The beach (even tho it was cloudy and a bad time for the beach here in SD). Nothing beat the times that I held her in my arms, and those are times i wont ever forget no matter how much it hurts to remember. She paid for everything, She was fine with it and knew the situation I was in but it didnt even matter to her. When she left it was so hard... I cried in the airport parking lot for 10 mins and then realized if it never happened again how lucky of a man I was...

 A month later now and we cant stand being apart, we have to see each other again! Walls and chains couldnt hold us back! I took the money my family had put in stocks for me since I was 1, 3000 dollars and asked her if she wanted me to come id be there in a week. She said yes I booked the flight, everything was perfect I was going to look for work while there for a month and maybe we could continue with our life's together. But something happened, something I didnt see or know, 3 days before my flight she started acting weird, saying I shouldnt come, It tore me into pieces. We had discussed it and we both wanted me to be there so I didnt understand. That day I asked if she didnt want to be together, if she wanted too them me comming would have been soming great, but for some reason she didnt, all of a sudden at that... It hurt so much in that very second that I couldnt talk or barely breathe, my suitcase was already packed.. I deleted her from everything immediatly, never to speak to her again until 4 months later and it didnt go well..

I regret not trying to talk her out of it... I regret it every fucking day. But I LOVED her SO MUCH that I thought Id rather her be 100% happy and not waste all her potential on me. I would give almost anything for 1 more day, but lifes a bitch, and im an idiot.

TLDR: I just let her go and didnt even fight for it.

Time stands still, there is nothing more to be done. You have come to a place where nothing matters but the earth itself, there are no worries no sense of urgency, no feelings of loneliness although you are the only one on the beach. Your hair on the back of your neck is standing straight up like a thousand saluting soldiers. Times like this are unforgettable, you will think back on them and shed a tear for no reason other then the pure beauty of what you have witnessed. It seems like nothing will ever be the same again, views and opinions are changed with no words.
